name: Nacho Dip
description: A creamy and flavorful dip made with cream cheese, sour cream, and taco seasoning, topped with salsa, cheese, and chopped vegetables.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine cream cheese, sour cream, and taco seasoning mix until smooth.
Spread the mixture in a large glass pan.
Spread salsa sauce over the cream cheese layer.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the salsa layer.
Add chopped red pepper, green pepper, and tomato on top.

keywords: nacho dip, creamy dip, taco seasoning, salsa dip
